description: Three-letter to one-letter mapping for the residues these structures contain, including the modified residues that appear in deposited coordinates. A comp id outside this table makes the build refuse rather than map to X, because an unmapped residue would silently drop out of the sequence-agreement count.
modified_residue_note: MSE (selenomethionine) maps to M and HYP to P because the structure records the modified residue where the UniProt sequence records the parent. Mapping them to X instead would make every selenomethionine position read as a sequence disagreement.
